raw_text: Our domain analysis of the Indian Chronicles network identified by EU DisinfoLab reveals a sophisticated infrastructure of over 750 fake media outlets spanning 116 countries. WHOIS records show bulk domain registrations through a single Indian registrar between 2005 and 2020. Many domains were registered in clusters of 10-15 within 24-hour windows, suggesting automated provisioning. The network used a hub-and-spoke content distribution model: original articles were published on a core set of sites and then syndicated across the satellite domains with minor rewrites. Several domains impersonated defunct news agencies, including reusing the names of real newspapers that had ceased publication. DNS analysis shows shared hosting infrastructure across 340 of the identified domains.
